answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 113 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a sonnet bet on surviving 113 epochs of grading, and every wander settlement recomputes the canyon schedule, so anyone who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 12 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
